rules.title: Application fee limit (Cambridge Municipal Code 8.70.020)
rules.requirement: Landlords of buildings with six or more units cannot charge a prospective tenant more than $25 for an application, screening, or processing fee.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to residential buildings containing six or more dwelling units.
rules.quoted_span: A landlord of a residential building containing six or more dwelling units shall not charge any prospective tenant an application fee, screening fee, or other charge for processing a rental application that exceeds twenty-five dollars ($25).
